text:
jamie-recruiter: Candidate Eli Anderson verbally accepted but requests a comp-band exception and a split sign-on because of cross-border tax timing + a requested clawback if performance targets not met in 12 months. Proposed cash = $230k (base 140k / target 40k / sign-on 50k). Request uplift to E4->E5 and sign-on 70% at start / 30% at 12mo. Start date 2026-10-04 (flexible 2 weeks).

nina-peopleops: Please upload offer packet, market comps and proposed clawback language. Confirm manager sign-off and whether sign-on gross-up requested.

eli-hm: Manager sign-off here. We support uplift due to scarcity. Clawback is usual: prorated repayment if <70% target achievement in 12 months, but manager requests softened terms for relocation hiccups.

jamie-recruiter: Packet uploaded gdrive.com/eli-offer; includes comps and proposed clawback clause. No gross-up requested but contingency for tax counsel review.

sophia-legal: Note: clawbacks and deferred sign-ons have jurisdictional limits. Need legal + tax counsel review on enforceability and repayment mechanics. Include proposed repayment triggers and candidate consent form.

frank-finance: Finance needs FY1 cashflow and GL ENG-PM-01. If 70% upfront, show P&L timing and potential recovery accounting if clawback triggered. Also confirm currency and bank routing for initial tranche.

paula-comp: Comp committee asked for 3 market comps and internal parity. If uplift consumes special pool, state headcount budget source. We'll review tomorrow; mark expedite if candidate hold <72h.

approvals-bot: Approval request created https://rbwd/approvals/REQ-2026-1015-21. Approvers: nina-peopleops, paula-comp, frank-finance, sophia-legal. Status: Pending.

nina-peopleops: Added "72-hr candidate hold" note. I'll attach the market comps and cashflow now. @paula-comp please triage.

paula-comp: I'll pull the packet and aim to decide within 48 hours. Two asks: clarify repayment cap (max sign-on amount) and show how relocation delays are carved out.

jamie-recruiter: Noted  will update packet with repayment cap and carve-outs. I'll keep candidate on 72-hr hold and update thread when approvals move. :thumbsup:
